 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. After a massive 75-65 win over then-No. 8 Vanderbilt on Sunday, No. 10 Iowa women's basketball (4-1) returns to action Thursday night as the Hawkeyes host Montana State (2-0) at Carver-Hawkeye Arena for their first-ever meeting with the Bobcats.
 In Iowa's last time out, Chit-Chat Wright led the way with 16 points, alongside three other Hawkeyes who finished with double-figure scoring. Most notably, both Ava Heiden and Amari Whiting registered points-rebounds double-doubles and were key to Iowa's continued offensive rhythm. On defense, the Hawkeyes held Vanderbilt to 36% shooting from the field and 16% from 3-point range.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As for Montana State, it enters Thursday night's contest following wins over Black Hills State, 82-38, on Nov. 2, and Portland, 75-65, on Nov. 8. The Bobcats are led offensively by junior Addison Harris (older sister of Iowa men's basketball guard Ethan Harris), who averages 20.5 points and 6.5 rebounds per game and tied her career high with 27 points, plus seven rebounds, three steals, and three blocks in Montana State's win over Portland.
